description: Source code for MAX30101 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, sample fetching, and channel reading functions.

methods.name: max30101_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a sample from the MAX30101 sensor, reading FIFO data into raw buffer.

methods.name: max30101_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for a specific channel (red, IR, green) and converts raw data to sensor_value.

methods.name: max30101_init
methods.description: Initializes the MAX30101 sensor, configures registers, and sets up channel mapping.
